committee_name.text: No advisory committee was convened for this application (BLA 125249/S-049, recurrent pericarditis). The review documents do, however, describe a prior Arthritis Advisory Committee (AAC) meeting held for a separate, non-approved gout-flare BLA supplement.

quote.quote: A meeting was convened with the Arthritis Advisory Committee (AAC) on 08 MAY 2012 to evaluate the benefit/risk profile from the BLA supplement.

meeting_date.text: No meeting for this approval. The prior AAC meeting (for the gout-flare supplement, not this pericarditis approval) was held 08 MAY 2012.

quote.quote: A meeting was convened with the Arthritis Advisory Committee (AAC) on 08 MAY 2012 to evaluate the benefit/risk profile from the BLA supplement.

recommendation.text: No recommendation for this approval (no AC convened). At the 2012 AAC for the gout-flare supplement, the committee voted 11-0 against approval; that gout supplement received a complete response (non-approval). This pericarditis supplement (S-049) was approved without an AC.

linkages.concern: At the 2012 Arthritis Advisory Committee (held for the separate, non-approved gout-flare supplement), members judged the small numerical increase in cancer events in the rilonacept arm to be real, raising concern that the drug's immunosuppressive action could increase malignancy risk.
linkages.change: A malignancy warning was placed in the ARCALYST product labeling; the clinical review states this warning adequately/sufficiently addresses the malignancy risk, and the warning carries over into this pericarditis approval's label.

concern_quote.quote: there was a small numerical increase in cancer events in the rilonacept arm (0.4%) compared to placebo (0%) considered real by the Arthritis Advisory Committee.

change_quote.quote: a warning was placed in the product label that adequately addresses this risk.

no_adcom_quote.quote: There was no Advisory Committee meeting for this efficacy supplement because it did not raise any significant safety or efficacy issues.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for BLA 125249/S-049 (ARCALYST/rilonacept for recurrent pericarditis, approved 18 Mar 2021); the review states it raised no significant safety or efficacy issues (also noted plainly as 'There was no Advisory Committee'). The review documents do describe a prior Arthritis Advisory Committee meeting (08 May 2012) convened for a separate gout-flare supplement, which voted 11-0 against approval of that (non-approved) indication. That committee judged a small malignancy signal to be real, and the review ties that assessment to a malignancy warning placed in the product label, which persists in this pericarditis approval's labeling.
